props.name: destination_conf
props.description:
Uniquely identifies a resource (such as an s3 bucket) where data.
will be pushed. Additional configuration parameters supported by the destination
may be included.

props.name: account_id
props.description:
The Account ID to use for this endpoint. Mutually exclusive with the
Zone ID.

props.name: zone_id
props.description:
The Zone ID to use for this endpoint. Mutually exclusive with the
Account ID.

props.name: dataset
props.description:
Name of the dataset. A list of supported datasets can be found on
the
[Developer Docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/reference/log-fields/).

props.name: enabled
props.description: Flag that indicates if the job is enabled.

props.name: filter
props.description:
The filters to select the events to include and/or remove from your
logs. For more information, refer to
[Filters](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/reference/filters/).

props.name: kind
props.description:
The kind parameter (optional) is used to differentiate between
Logpush and Edge Log Delivery jobs (when supported by the dataset).

props.name: max_upload_bytes
props.description:
The maximum uncompressed file size of a batch of logs. This setting
value must be between `5 MB` and `1 GB`, or `0` to disable it. Note that you
cannot set a minimum file size; this means that log files may be much smaller
than this batch size.

props.name: max_upload_interval_seconds
props.description:
The maximum interval in seconds for log batches. This setting must
be between 30 and 300 seconds (5 minutes), or `0` to disable it. Note that you
cannot specify a minimum interval for log batches; this means that log files may
be sent in shorter intervals than this.

props.name: max_upload_records
props.description:
The maximum number of log lines per batch. This setting must be
between 1000 and 1,000,000 lines, or `0` to disable it. Note that you cannot
specify a minimum number of log lines per batch; this means that log files may
contain many fewer lines than this.

props.name: name
props.description:
Optional human readable job name. Not unique. Cloudflare suggests.
that you set this to a meaningful string, like the domain name, to make it
easier to identify your job.

props.name: output_options
batch_prefix
props.description: String to be prepended before each batch.

props.name: batch_suffix
props.description: String to be appended after each batch.

props.name: CVE-2021-44228
props.description:
If set to true, will cause all occurrences of `${` in the generated files to be
replaced with `x{`.

props.name: field_delimiter
props.description: String to join fields. This field be ignored when `record_template` is set.

props.name: field_names
props.description:
List of field names to be included in the Logpush output. For the moment, there
is no option to add all fields at once, so you must specify all the fields names
you are interested in.

props.name: merge_subrequests
props.description:
If set to true, subrequests will be merged into the parent request. Only
supported for the `http_requests` dataset.

props.name: output_type
props.description:
Specifies the output type, such as `ndjson` or `csv`. This sets default values
for the rest of the settings, depending on the chosen output type. Some
formatting rules, like string quoting, are different between output types.

props.name: record_delimiter
props.description: String to be inserted in-between the records as separator.

props.name: record_prefix
props.description: String to be prepended before each record.

props.name: record_suffix
props.description: String to be appended after each record.

props.name: record_template
props.description:
String to use as template for each record instead of the default json key value
mapping. All fields used in the template must be present in `field_names` as
well, otherwise they will end up as null. Format as a Go `text/template` without
any standard functions, like conditionals, loops, sub-templates, etc.

props.name: sample_rate
props.description:
Floating number to specify sampling rate. Sampling is applied on top of
filtering, and regardless of the current `sample_interval` of the data.

props.name: timestamp_format
props.description:
String to specify the format for timestamps, such as `unixnano`, `unix`,
`rfc3339`, `rfc3339ms` or `rfc3339ns`.

The structured replacement for `logpull_options`. When including
this field, the `logpull_option` field will be ignored.

props.name: ownership_challenge
props.description: Ownership challenge token to prove destination ownership.

props.description:

Zone ID.
